picks.title: Uprising
picks.highlight: 雷鬼传奇《Uprising》再版，原声律动与反叛精神依旧滚烫，适合从头到尾整张循环，感受经典现场感。
picks.highlightEn: Reggae legend’s Uprising reissue still burns with acoustic grooves and rebel spirit—spin it whole for a classic live feel.
picks.summary: Bob Marley 晚期代表作再版，融合根源雷鬼、原声质感与政治表达，旋律温暖且具历史分量。
picks.summaryEn: A reissue of Bob Marley’s late-career statement, blending roots reggae, acoustic warmth and political conviction with lasting historical weight.

picks.title: The Stooges
picks.highlight: 原型朋克开山之作再版，粗粝吉他、原始鼓点与 Iggy 的狂野能量，一次听完血脉偾张。
picks.highlightEn: The proto-punk landmark reissued: raw guitars, primal drums and Iggy’s wild energy make it a blood-pumping full listen.
picks.summary: The Stooges 首张专辑再版，车库摇滚与原型朋克的原始爆发力，定义了后来的朋克美学。
picks.summaryEn: The Stooges’ debut reissue captures garage-rock and proto-punk’s raw explosion, defining the punk aesthetic to come.

picks.title: CANDY TUNE SOLO BOX
picks.highlight: 日本偶像团体 CANDY TUNE 的独唱礼盒，甜酷能量与舞台感满载，日系流行乐迷别错过。
picks.highlightEn: CANDY TUNE’s solo box bursts with sweet-cool idol energy and stage-ready J-pop charm—essential for Japanese pop fans.
picks.summary: 日本偶像组合的独唱合集，收录多成员个人曲目，呈现元气、甜酷与舞台感，适合 J-Pop 粉丝。
picks.summaryEn: A solo collection from Japanese idol group CANDY TUNE, featuring member tracks full of energy, sweet-cool appeal and stage presence.

picks.title: The Power Station
picks.highlight: 80年代超级组合经典再版，鼓机、放克吉他与华丽摇滚气质交织，复古派对感十足。
picks.highlightEn: This 80s supergroup reissue mixes drum machines, funk guitars and glam-rock swagger into a retro party rush.
picks.summary: The Power Station 经典专辑再版，融合流行摇滚、放克与80年代制作质感，旋律硬朗且舞池友好。
picks.summaryEn: The Power Station’s classic reissue fuses pop-rock, funk and 80s production gloss with hard hooks and dancefloor appeal.

picks.title: RAVEPOP
picks.artist: r u s s e l b u c k
picks.highlight: 高能快乐硬核与 Donk 拼贴，彩色噪音、夸张节拍和网络文化狂欢，越听越上头。
picks.highlightEn: High-energy happy hardcore and donk collide in a hyper-colored rush of loud beats and internet-culture chaos.
picks.summary: r u s s e l b u c k 把快乐硬核、Donk、Jersey club 等元素高速拼贴，色彩艳丽、情绪亢奋且极具当下网络感。
picks.summaryEn: r u s s e l b u c k rapidly collages happy hardcore, donk and Jersey club into a loud, euphoric and very online sound.

picks.title: Snow, Vol. 9
picks.highlight: Wun Two 的冬日 Lo-Fi 系列第九卷，松软鼓点与暖色采样，适合循环放空。
picks.highlightEn: Wun Two’s Snow Vol. 9 drifts on soft drums and warm samples—an easy loop for winter-day zoning out.
picks.summary: Wun Two 的器乐嘻哈/Lo-Fi 系列新作，鼓点松弛、采样温暖，保持高人气与稳定氛围感。
picks.summaryEn: A new entry in Wun Two’s instrumental hip-hop/Lo-Fi series, with loose drums and warm samples that stay reliably atmospheric.

picks.title: Monument
picks.highlight: 哥特金属老牌 Crematory 新作，厚重吉他、黑暗旋律与工业冷感交织，气势沉稳。
picks.highlightEn: Crematory return with heavy guitars, dark melodies and industrial chill—gothic metal delivered with steady force.
picks.summary: Crematory 新专辑延续哥特金属与工业金属路线，厚重音墙、黑暗旋律和现代制作兼具压迫感与旋律性。
picks.summaryEn: Crematory’s new album continues their gothic and industrial metal path, balancing heavy walls of sound, dark melody and modern production.

picks.title: The Great Adventure
picks.highlight: 瑞士舞曲常青树 DJ BoBo 的冒险新篇，明亮旋律、家庭友好节奏与欧陆派对能量。
picks.highlightEn: Swiss dance veteran DJ BoBo delivers bright melodies, family-friendly rhythms and Euro-party energy on a new adventure.
picks.summary: DJ BoBo 新作延续欧陆舞曲路线，旋律明亮、节奏亲和，展现瑞士流行舞曲的长青魅力。
picks.summaryEn: DJ BoBo’s new album continues his Eurodance path with bright melodies and accessible rhythms, showing Swiss pop-dance longevity.

picks.title: Big Cock
picks.highlight: 英国心理摇滚怪团回归，Rockabilly 低音、狂野萨克斯与恶趣味幽默，派对感十足。
picks.highlightEn: British psychobilly oddballs return with rockabilly bass, wild sax and cheeky humor—built for a messy party.
picks.summary: King Kurt 以心理摇滚与 Rockabilly 为底色，加入萨克斯和怪诞幽默，风格鲜明、现场感强但相对小众。
picks.summaryEn: King Kurt blend psychobilly and rockabilly with sax and grotesque humor—distinctive, live-wire and happily cultish.

picks.title: Fantasy
picks.highlight: 超长拼贴浩室幻想曲，采样碎片、怀旧旋律与持续推进的节奏拼成一场甜蜜又迷幻的梦境。
picks.highlightEn: A long-form plunderphonic house fantasy where sample shards, nostalgic hooks and steady grooves form a sweet, trippy dream.
picks.summary: DJ Sabrina the Teenage DJ 擅长拼贴与浩室叙事，专辑采样丰富、旋律怀旧，情绪从甜蜜走向迷幻。
picks.summaryEn: DJ Sabrina the Teenage DJ excels at plunderphonic house storytelling, with rich samples and nostalgic hooks moving from sweet to psychedelic.

picks.title: Nothing Hurts Like Everything
picks.highlight: 加拿大独立音乐人 Ourson 的私密新作，柔软人声与朦胧编曲包裹痛感，适合深夜独听。
picks.highlightEn: Ourson’s intimate new record wraps pain in soft vocals and hazy arrangements—made for late-night solo listening.
picks.summary: Ourson 以独立流行和氛围编曲营造私密空间，人声柔软、情绪克制，适合静听但知名度不高。
picks.summaryEn: Ourson builds an intimate space with indie-pop and atmospheric arrangements, soft vocals and restrained emotion for close listening.

picks.title: THE PROTÉGÉ
picks.highlight: 香港唱作人 Gareth.T 的成长企划，粤语与英文交错，R&B 质感里藏着锋利自省。
picks.highlightEn: Hong Kong singer-songwriter Gareth.T’s growth project weaves Cantonese and English through sharp, R&B-tinted self-reflection.
picks.summary: Gareth.T 新作融合粤语流行、英文唱作与 R&B 质感，主题围绕成长与自我审视，代表香港新一代声音。
picks.summaryEn: Gareth.T blends Cantopop, English songwriting and R&B texture around growth and self-scrutiny, representing a new Hong Kong voice.

picks.title: Von Abseits
picks.highlight: 德国地下嘻哈组合新作，冷峻德语押韵、粗粝节拍与旁观者视角，硬度与思辨并存。
picks.highlightEn: German underground hip-hop with cold German rhymes, rough beats and an outsider’s view—hard-edged yet thoughtful.
picks.summary: Doppelkopf 以德语说唱和地下嘻哈为基底，节拍粗粝、表达冷峻，保持思辨视角与地下质感。
picks.summaryEn: Doppelkopf ground the album in German rap and underground hip-hop, with rough beats, cold delivery and a reflective outsider stance.

picks.title: Labor of Love
picks.highlight: 蓝调吉他手 Tinsley Ellis 的情感力作，粗粝嗓音与炙热推弦，献给漫长音乐路。
picks.highlightEn: Blues guitarist Tinsley Ellis offers a heartfelt set of gritty vocals and fiery slide work—a tribute to the long road.
picks.summary: Tinsley Ellis 以蓝调与蓝调摇滚为骨架，吉他推弦炙热、嗓音粗粝，情感表达成熟而真挚。
picks.summaryEn: Tinsley Ellis builds on blues and blues-rock with fiery slide guitar and gritty vocals, delivering mature and sincere emotion.

picks.title: Appalachia
picks.highlight: Emily Scott Robinson 以阿巴拉契亚为卷，细腻叙事、温暖和声与山地气息缓缓展开。
picks.highlightEn: Emily Scott Robinson unfolds Appalachia through detailed storytelling, warm harmonies and a deep mountain atmosphere.
picks.summary: 专辑以美式民谣和乡村唱作为核心，叙事细腻、和声温暖，围绕阿巴拉契亚的地域记忆展开。
picks.summaryEn: Rooted in Americana and country songwriting, it tells detailed stories with warm harmonies around Appalachian memory and place.

picks.title: RE-FLOW
picks.highlight: ZB1全新迷你专辑《RE-FLOW》，九人声线在合成器与舞曲节拍间流动，主打舞台值得循环。
picks.highlightEn: ZEROBASEONE's new EP RE-FLOW: nine voices flowing through synths and dance beats — the title track begs for repeat plays.
picks.summary: 韩国新生代男团高完成度舞曲EP，旋律抓耳、编曲层次分明，是本周K-Pop代表。
picks.summaryEn: A polished dance-pop EP from Korea's rising boy group — hooky melodies and layered production, this week's K-pop pick.
